executive_summary.conclusion: The inspected public pages make the offer, cost conditions, enrollment eligibility and in-person next step easy to extract, with direct links between the enrollment guide and application instructions. Rendered interaction, independent corroboration and actual assistant citation behavior were unavailable, so this audit records no prioritized defect and keeps those lanes open for follow-up.

not_checked: Rendered extraction and interactive behavior were not checked because browser tools were prohibited.
Mobile layout, keyboard reachability, visible focus, overlays and context retention were not checked.
Independent off-site corroboration and retrieval validation were not checked because public search was unavailable in this audit path.
Actual assistant answers, citations, provider IP access, Search Console settings and behavioral analytics were not measured.

readiness.detail: robots.txt permits the inspected path for Googlebot, bingbot, OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot and the recorded training/user-fetch roles. This is policy evidence, not proof of provider access.
Five first-party HTML pages returned 200 and exposed readable titles, headings, main text and task links in static source capture.
Four representative visitor questions were tested against the supplied page and selected task destinations; each required element is supported by a captured passage.
No independent public source was opened; first-party consistency was inspected only within the five-page sample.
Two source journeys reached public information and next-step destinations through observed labeled links; rendered interaction remains untested.
